lede: The Telluride Film Festival kicks off Friday, so the box canyon is about to get loud and crowded in the best way — plan your commutes accordingly. On the government side, Mountain Village's Design Review Board meets Wednesday on a conditional-use permit for a tent and food truck setup at 332 Adams Ranch Rd, which heads to Town Council for a final call. Most other boards this week haven't posted agendas yet.

notable.stake: Conditional-use permit for tent and food truck heads to Town Council.
